title: Opening the link serves the Snake game
description: Anyone who opens the deployed link gets the game with no install or account: the page answers, names the game, and shows the play area with a run ready to start.

steps.goal: On the Snake game page, look at what it shows without signing in or installing anything. Check whether a play area (the game board) is visible, and whether a run can be started right away, either because it is already running or through one obvious start control.
success: A play area was visible on the page
A run could be started right away, either already live or through one obvious start control
No error or blank page was shown
